programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel, Tim Motzer & Gintas Janusonis
programme.desc: Jazzfest Bonn is an annual festival of modern and creative jazz music. Every May it presents local and international jazz musicians in concert halls all over the German city. Among the artists of the 2017 edition is Bandit 65, a trio of breathtaking virtuosity, great power, boundless breadth, and astounding beauty. Together with Tim Motzer on guitar and electronics, and Gintas Janusonis on drums and percussion, guitarist and band leader Kurt Rosenwinkel explores the intersection of guitars, rhythm, electronics, soundscapes, free improvisation, and telepathic interplay.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson Trio, Stuff Smith & Ella Fitzgerald
programme.sub-title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. The Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson and his trio of guitarist Herb Ellis and bassist Ray Brown are later joined by trumpeter Roy Eldridge and drummer Jo Jones. As an added attraction, American violinist Stuff Smith joins the proceedings. American singer Ella Fitzgerald, accompanied by pianist Don Abney, Ellis, Brown and Jones, hits her vocal peak in a stunning set that culminates in a jam session of It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing) with the entire ensemble.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Robert Glasper & Jason Moran
programme.sub-title: La Gaité Lyrique: Robert Glasper & Jason Moran
programme.desc: As part of the Blue Note Jazz Festival and Blue Note Records' 75th anniversary, pianists Robert Glasper and Jason Moran delivered a stunning jazz piano duet, resulting in an exciting exploration of the great history of jazz. An intricate knowledge of African-American music is infused with modern energy. The two musicians reinterpret the stride piano tradition through captivating original songs and personal interpretations of the music of Albert Ammons, Andrew Hill, Thelonious Monk, Ornette Coleman and Herbie Hancock.

programme.title: Christian Scott
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Sun Ra
programme.sub-title: Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Featuring saxophonists Marshall Allen, John Gilmore and Danny Ray Thompson, clarinetist Eloe Omoe, flautist James Jackson, trombonist Tyrone Hill and a cavalcade of other costumed talents, Sun Ra puts on a truly out-of-this-world concert.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 6 consists of five movements, of which the last three are played without a break. Each movement carries a title that suggests a scene from life in the countryside. The joyful atmosphere of the first three movements is interrupted by the violent fourth movement ‘Thunder, Storm', as expressed by the piccolos, brass, and timpani. As the storm recedes at the end of the movement, the tranquility returns in the final movement. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major, K. 216. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. With the exception of the first violin concerto, Mozart composed his other four violin concertos in 1775 at a time when he was concertmaster at the Salzburg court. Violin Concerto No. 3 opens with a theme the composer borrowed from the aria ‘Aer tranquillo' of his then recent opera Il re pastore. In the beautiful Adagio, the strings are muted and the oboes make way for the flutes, which only sound in the second movement. The finale movement has a dance-like character. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Royal Opera Orchestra & Andres Gabetta
programme.desc: We all know "The Four Seasons of Vivaldi", it is one of the "hits" of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi's famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV? The two works are finally presented in the same program in spite of their differences: the well-known virtuosity of Vivaldi's work contrasts with the mixture of French good taste and Italian features of Guido's Seasons. It is also the first time that the version with strings and winds is filmed. For this exciting confrontation, the Royal Opera Orchestra will be conducted by the virtuoso Andrès Gabetta, from his 1727 Venetian Pietro Guarneri violin, an exact contemporary of these Eight Seasons!

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.desc: Bruce Willis stars as an imprisoned officer who refuses to give up his fight to defeat the Nazis in this “absorbing” (Roger Ebert) WWII adventure. When Col. McNamara (Willis) is held captive in a German POW camp, he's resolved to keep on fighting, even from behind enemy lines.

programme.title: Traffic
programme.desc: A patchwork of stories about various factions of the drug trade, including dealers, abusers and the law enforcement officials who pursue them.

programme.title: The Client
programme.desc: A young boy witnesses a mafia lawyer take his own life and so hires a lawyer to help him out, when the District Attorney wants to use him to bring down a mob family.

programme.title: Dark Tide
programme.desc: A professional diver tutor returns to deep waters after a year, following an almost fatal encounter with a great white shark. The nightmare from the deep is still lurking and it's even hungrier than before.

programme.title: Grand Isle
programme.desc: A young father is charged with murder and must prove his innocence by recalling a very twisted and dark night of events.

programme.title: Somewhere in Time
programme.desc: A Chicago playwright uses self-hypnosis to journey back in time and meet the actress whose old portrait hangs in an elegant hotel.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: Hellboy: The Crooked Man
programme.desc: In the 1950s, Hellboy is enlisted to aid rookie paranormal researcher, Bobbie Jo Song, in the transportation of a deadly creature. However, their mission soon goes awry when an accident leaves them stranded in the forests of rural Appalachia, where a small community resides, haunted by demonic forces. With all clues pointing towards witchcraft as the culprit, Hellboy and his allies must hunt down the source of this evil - a being known as 'The Crooked Man' who has been sent to Earth to harvest souls for the devil.

programme.title: Spooks: The Greater Good
programme.desc: When a terrorist escapes custody during a routine handover, Will Holloway must team with disgraced MI5 Intelligence Chief Harry Pearce to track him down before an imminent terrorist attack on London.

programme.title: Shutter
programme.desc: A newly married couple discovers disturbing, ghostly images in photographs they develop after an eerie accident in which they believe they may have hit a young girl with their car.

programme.title: Gladiatress
programme.desc: 55BC Somewhere In Britain: The Princesses of the Dubonni tribe are three unlikely sisters: Smirgut The Fierce (Fiona Allen), ferocious warrior and full-time mum, Dwyfuc (Doon Mackichan), desperate spinster in search of a hairy husband and Worthaboutapig (Sally Phillips), clumsy village bee-herder. Roman soldiers kidnap Dwyfuc, detaining her in Boulogne. Seduced by Roman society, she reveals locations of British ports crucial to the Romanss invasion strategy. Smirgut and Worthaboutapig set out on a perilous rescue mission together they must prevent the downfall of Celtic Britain, encountering gods, lawyers, soothsayers, barbarians and the Otherworld. Girl power is alive and kicking and ready to take on the Romans

programme.title: Deadly Target
programme.desc: When Special Operative James Webster (Michael Jai White, The Dark Knight, Blood and Bone) returns home from duty to find his brother brutally murdered, his lethal training immediately kicks in. Fuelled by rage and a burning need to avenge his brother, he sets out to hunt down the perpetrators and nothing is going to stand in his way... As he delves deeper to identify the murderers, he finds himself at the centre of a deadly conspiracy and a secret world of corruption one which cuts deep inside the U.S. Government, reaching the very highest levels of command. With a ruthless military assassin (Steve Austin, The Expendables) hot on his trail, Webster must expose the corrupt high-ranking officials before he becomes another victim to the very plot which killed his brother.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: Imperium
programme.desc: Daniel Radcliffe (Harry Potter) plays Nate, a young FBI agent who goes undercover to expose a radical white supremacy terrorist group. Under a new identity and immersed in a deeply unsettling, hate-filled world, Nate must control his own beliefs whilst identifying the threat and keeping his true motives a secret. Inspired by true events, this compelling story also stars Toni Collette (Hereditary).

programme.title: 16 Blocks
programme.desc: From director of action blockbuster Lethal Weapon, Richard Donner. Personal demons put cop Jack (Bruce Willis - Die Hard) at rock bottom but he wasn't about to let a witness be murdered on his watch. When he's assigned to escort a petty criminal to testify before the grand jury, a violent turn of events means this down-and-out cop needs to pull it together as he is hunted across New York City.

programme.title: White Mountain
programme.desc: This jaw-dropping climbing, Free Solo-esque documentary is a harrowing story of friendship, bravery and tragedy in one of the harshest environments known to man. 6 years after their trip to Dhaulagiri in the Himalayas to reach the peak of the almost mythical and rarely-climbed white wall, a group of Argentine climbers return to get closure on a fellow climber who was never to be seen again.

programme.title: A Young Man with High Potential
programme.desc: This shocking, controversial horror thriller sees an uptight man succumb to his inner desires. Piet is a socially awkward, lonely and reclusive student, who catches up on classes online. This changes when he is forced to partner a project with new student Klara. Soon he becomes fixated with her. After his advances are rebuffed, he starts down a dark and despicable path.

programme.title: Donnybrook
programme.desc: In this kill-or-be-killed world, all roads lead to the Donnybrook: an illicit backwoods cage match where bare-knuckled fighters brawl for a shot at a $100,000 prize.

programme.title: Little Accidents
programme.desc: Both dramatic and suspenseful, Little Accidents shows the different ways in which people respond to tragedy.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Academy Award® nominees Naomi Watts (King Kong, Mulholland Drive) and Matt Dillon (There's Something About Mary, Crash) star in this thrilling and intense story about a young couple at odds with the American Dream. Melissa Winters (Watts) works as a cashier at the bleak local convenience store...

programme.title: I Am Woman
programme.desc: The story of Helen Reddy, who in 1966 landed in NYC with her three-year-old daughter, a suitcase and $230 in her pocket. Within five years she was one of the biggest superstars of her time, and an icon of the 1970s feminist movement.

programme.title: Please Stand By

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel, Tim Motzer & Gintas Janusonis
programme.desc: Jazzfest Bonn is an annual festival of modern and creative jazz music. Every May it presents local and international jazz musicians in concert halls all over the German city. Among the artists of the 2017 edition is Bandit 65, a trio of breathtaking virtuosity, great power, boundless breadth, and astounding beauty. Together with Tim Motzer on guitar and electronics, and Gintas Janusonis on drums and percussion, guitarist and band leader Kurt Rosenwinkel explores the intersection of guitars, rhythm, electronics, soundscapes, free improvisation, and telepathic interplay.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson Trio, Stuff Smith & Ella Fitzgerald
programme.sub-title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. The Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson and his trio of guitarist Herb Ellis and bassist Ray Brown are later joined by trumpeter Roy Eldridge and drummer Jo Jones. As an added attraction, American violinist Stuff Smith joins the proceedings. American singer Ella Fitzgerald, accompanied by pianist Don Abney, Ellis, Brown and Jones, hits her vocal peak in a stunning set that culminates in a jam session of It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing) with the entire ensemble.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Robert Glasper & Jason Moran
programme.sub-title: La Gaité Lyrique: Robert Glasper & Jason Moran
programme.desc: As part of the Blue Note Jazz Festival and Blue Note Records' 75th anniversary, pianists Robert Glasper and Jason Moran delivered a stunning jazz piano duet, resulting in an exciting exploration of the great history of jazz. An intricate knowledge of African-American music is infused with modern energy. The two musicians reinterpret the stride piano tradition through captivating original songs and personal interpretations of the music of Albert Ammons, Andrew Hill, Thelonious Monk, Ornette Coleman and Herbie Hancock.

programme.title: Christian Scott
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Sun Ra
programme.sub-title: Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Featuring saxophonists Marshall Allen, John Gilmore and Danny Ray Thompson, clarinetist Eloe Omoe, flautist James Jackson, trombonist Tyrone Hill and a cavalcade of other costumed talents, Sun Ra puts on a truly out-of-this-world concert.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 6 consists of five movements, of which the last three are played without a break. Each movement carries a title that suggests a scene from life in the countryside. The joyful atmosphere of the first three movements is interrupted by the violent fourth movement ‘Thunder, Storm', as expressed by the piccolos, brass, and timpani. As the storm recedes at the end of the movement, the tranquility returns in the final movement. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major, K. 216. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. With the exception of the first violin concerto, Mozart composed his other four violin concertos in 1775 at a time when he was concertmaster at the Salzburg court. Violin Concerto No. 3 opens with a theme the composer borrowed from the aria ‘Aer tranquillo' of his then recent opera Il re pastore. In the beautiful Adagio, the strings are muted and the oboes make way for the flutes, which only sound in the second movement. The finale movement has a dance-like character. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Royal Opera Orchestra & Andres Gabetta
programme.desc: We all know "The Four Seasons of Vivaldi", it is one of the "hits" of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi's famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV? The two works are finally presented in the same program in spite of their differences: the well-known virtuosity of Vivaldi's work contrasts with the mixture of French good taste and Italian features of Guido's Seasons. It is also the first time that the version with strings and winds is filmed. For this exciting confrontation, the Royal Opera Orchestra will be conducted by the virtuoso Andrès Gabetta, from his 1727 Venetian Pietro Guarneri violin, an exact contemporary of these Eight Seasons!

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: Toto
programme.desc: This concert was recorded at Le Zenith in Paris in March 2007 in front of a wildly enthusiastic sell-out crowd. It captures Toto rocking at their hardest and most powerful and giving a new life to all their best loved tracks. The band formed in LA in the late 70's by a group of friends who were all much in demand session musicians. They went on to epitomize the classic American pop/rock sound of the 80's and 90's with hit albums and singles including Hold The Line, Africa, I'll Be Over You and the multi-Grammy winning worldwide hit Rosanna.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Rush's 'Time Machine' shows in 2010/11 were one of the most anticipated tours ever. Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centrepiece of the concerts. The shows also featured favourite tracks from across their lengthy career and two recent ones. As ever the concerts were a visual feast and sounded great with the band playing at the top of their form.

A partir de entonces, la vida de James se precipitará hacia un mundo oscuro y prohibido, dominado por el peligro, el sexo y la muerte.

programme.title: Mahoma, el mensajero de Dios
programme.desc: En el siglo VII, Mahoma recibe la visita del arcángel Gabriel, quien le persuade para que comunique a su pueblo la necesidad...

programme.title: Sorgo rojo
programme.desc: En la China de la década de 1930, una joven es enviada por su padre a casarse con un hombre muy rico, del que se dice que está enfermo de lepra.

programme.title: Yo compré una moto vampiro
programme.desc: Cuando el miembro de una banda de motoristas mata a un ocultista, el espíritu diabólico que la víctima evocaba se encarna en una moto averiada. Tras ser comprada y reparada, revelará su auténtica naturaleza y buscará vengarse del motero que causó su muerte y de cualquiera que se interponga en su camino.

programme.title: ¡Agáchate, maldito!
programme.desc: Un bandido de mala muerte y un experto en explosivos del IRA se rebelan contra el gobierno existente y se convierten en héroes de la Revolución Mexicana.

programme.title: Ragewar ES
programme.desc: Un mago demoníaco desafía a un programador informático a una batalla de tecnología contra hechicería

programme.title: El dulce porvenir
programme.desc: Un autobús escolar se despeña montaña abajo y se hunde en un lago helado. En el accidente mueren todos los niños del pueblo. El abogado Mitchell Stevens se entrevista con los padres y les propone llevar el caso a los tribunales.

programme.title: El balneario de Battle Creek
programme.desc: El excéntrico doctor John Harvey Kellog es un defensor acérrimo de la vida natural y también regenta un lujoso balneario en Battle Creek, donde reúne a numerosos personajes de clase alta para poner en práctica sus peculiares normas dieteticas.

programme.title: Titanic II
programme.desc: En el 100º aniversario del viaje del Titanic, un moderno crucero de lujo bautizado como Titanic 2, sigue la ruta de su homónimo. Pero cuando un tsunami lanza un iceberg en la trayectoria del nuevo buque, los pasajeros y la tripulación deben luchar para ev

programme.title: El mal hijo
programme.desc: Varias chicas son asesinadas en las afueras de Seattle. El principal sospechoso es un apuesto joven.

programme.title: Desafío
programme.desc: lo que empieza siendo un juego divertido y desenfadado acabará por convertirse en una auténtica pesadilla.

programme.title: Emergencias
programme.desc: Situaciones de emergencias al límite.

programme.title: Matar por popularidad
programme.desc: Una cuenta revela escándalos de un instituto y dos amigas buscan desenmascarar al responsable.

programme.title: Traición conyugal
programme.desc: Una mujer que espía a su esposo descubre un secreto.

programme.title: La lectora
programme.desc: Un novelista ciego tras un accidente de coche en el que también falleció su mujer, redescubre su pasión perdida por la vida y la escritura cuando comienza un romance con la mujer de un hombre de negocios condenado.

programme.title: J.T. Leroy: Engañando a Hollywood
programme.desc: JT LeRoy (Kristen Stewart) fue una joven mujer que fingió ser un conocido autor literario que se identificaba como un hombre transexual, engañando a los ricos y famosos en Hollywood, el mundo de la moda y los círculos de la élite literaria. La joven se pasó seis años fingiendo ser el conocido autor.

programme.title: Medianoche permanente
programme.desc: La prometedora carrera de un escritor de comedia se descarrila por completo por sus locas adicciones a las drogas que lo tienen perseguido por marionetas y disparando mientras cuida a su hija pequeña.

programme.title: Ojos que te acechan
programme.desc: "El Ojo" es un agente especial del Servicio Británico, cuya misión es seguir a Joanna Eris, una mujer sospechosa de chantajear a un miembro del gobierno.

programme.title: Tierra firme
programme.desc: Dos mujeres, Eva y Kat, y el mejor amigo de una de ellas, Roger. Un barco en los canales de Londres y una pregunta: ¿Es posible vivir el amor, la familia, y la vida de formas tan distintas y aún así permanecer unidos?

programme.title: Primavera, verano, otoño, invierno... y primavera
programme.desc: En un templo flotante, un joven monje crece bajo la tutela de su maestro. Su vida —desde el despertar sexual hasta la caída y redención— se refleja en el ciclo de las estaciones y la naturaleza. Un viaje espiritual sobre el pecado y la purificación que culmina con un nuevo renacimiento.

programme.title: The Frost
programme.desc: A raíz de la muerte en un accidente de su único hijo, Rita y Alfred viven dominados por los remordimientos. Su sentimiento de culpa los lleva a reconocer que han vivido tan obsesionados con sus pequeñas y egoístas necesidades que olvidaron amar a su hijo. Esa dolorosa verdad los tortura sin tregua.

programme.title: El glorioso caos de la vida (Babyteeth)
programme.desc: Milla es una adolescente que se enamora locamente de Moses, aunque eso se convierte en la peor pesadilla para sus padres. Poco a poco Milla descubre lo que significa realmente el amor, y lo que podría haber sido un desastre, pronto les permite disfrutar del glorioso caos que representa la vida.

programme.title: Parecía un hombre tranquilo
programme.desc: Bob es un oficinista gris, aburrido y tímido que siempre va con la cabeza gacha. Pero tras un violento incidente que ocurre en su lugar de trabajo, se convierte en un héroe. En un acto de furiosa violencia, aunque casi involuntario, salva la vida a Vanessa, la chica por la que suspiran todos.

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Cuando el puente de San Luis se derrumba, los viajeros caen al abismo.

programme.title: Palm Swings
programme.desc: Tras mudarse a Palm Springs, un matrimonio pone a prueba su amor al descubrir que sus vecinos son swingers.

programme.title: El amor te encuentra en San Valentín
programme.desc: Kennedy hereda un rancho en un pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: El problema con el muérdago
programme.desc: Reencuentro con un primer amor: el reto de no caer dos veces.

programme.title: Un trabajo embarazoso
programme.desc: Thea, una joven ejecutiva, finge estar embarazada para evitar que su empresa la despida. Cuando todo el mundo multiplica sus atenciones hacia ella y empieza a recibir cada vez más ayuda, no le queda otra salida que mantener la mentira durante nueve meses.

programme.title: October Gale
programme.desc: Tras una fuerte tormenta, un doctor encuentra un hombre lavándose en la orilla del río cercana a su cabaña en la remota isla canadiense de Helen Matthews. Viéndole sangrar a causa de una herida de bala y medio inconsciente es trasladado por el médico dentro del hogar.

programme.title: Señor y Señora Adelman
programme.desc: Sarah y Victor llevan juntos más de 45 años. ¿Cómo lo han conseguido? ¿Quién es en realidad Sarah, esa enigmática mujer que ha estado siempre a la sombra de su marido? El amor, la ambición y los secretos alimentan la odisea de esta pareja poco corriente.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: Un manitas con problemas matrimoniales se encuentra con un ama de casa con los mismos.

programme.title: Buenas noches, mamá
programme.desc: Es pleno verano y dos hermanos gemelos esperan pacientemente a que su madre regrese a casa tras una operación de cirugía plástica. Cuando llega con la cara completamente vendada, se muestra fría, distante y obsesiva. El cambio en su personalidad hará que los niños se pregunten si la mujer que ha llegado es realmente su madre o se trata de una impostora.

programme.title: Adiós, felicidad
programme.desc: Cuatro hermanos que no tienen buena relación entre ellos se reencuentran en la casa de campo de su infancia tras la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Barbara
programme.desc: Brigitte, una actriz reconocida internacionalmente, llega a París para interpretar en una película a la icónica cantante francesa Barbara. A medida que pasan los días, la realidad y la ficción se irán confundiendo para el equipo de rodaje y también para la propia actriz.

programme.title: Contaminación: Alien invade la Tierra
programme.desc: Un astronauta ayuda a agentes del gubernamentales y a un detective en la investigación de unas misteriosas esporas alienígenas.

programme.title: ¡Déjate llevar!
programme.desc: Elia es un psicoanalista freudiano judío en Roma al que el médico le recomienda una dieta estricta y algo de deporte para bajar unos kilos de más. Así es como conoce a Claudia, una atractiva entrenadora personal obsesionada con el culto al cuerpo, pero mucho menos de la mente.

programme.title: Igelak
programme.desc: Pello decide huir y cambiar de identidad, pero acaba viviendo en un edificio okupa.

programme.title: La Primera Navidad
programme.desc: Un ladrón y un sacerdote viajan 2.000 años atrás y deben encontrar las figuras de la Natividad.

programme.title: Amanece en Edimburgo
programme.desc: Dos soldados regresan a su casa en Edimburgo para reanudar su vida romántica y familiar.

programme.title: El Furgón
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un accidente de tráfico, tres delincuentes escapan del furgón policial.

programme.title: Cortes peligrosos
programme.desc: Las estilistas de una peluquería de Dublín se convierten en heroínas al enfrentarse a la gente que pone en peligro su comunidad.

programme.title: Los babymakers
programme.desc: Divertida comedia cargada de chistes sexuales sobre un hombre que, tras varios intentos de dejar embarazada a su mujer sin éxito, pide a sus amigos que roben el depósito de esperma que años atrás dejó en un banco de donaciones. Empieza una divertida misión con un solo objetivo: tener un hijo.

programme.title: Mi super ex-novia
programme.desc: Matt Saunders es un joven neoyorquino que se enamora de Jenny Johnson, una chica aparentemente normal que resulta ser G-Girl, una superheroína. Cuando Matt decide acabar con la relación, Jenny decidirá hacer uso de sus superpoderes para hacer de la vida de Matt un auténtico infierno...

programme.title: Sick of Myself
programme.desc: Signe y Thomas están en una relación competitiva poco saludable que da un giro vicioso cuando Thomas de repente se abre paso como artista contemporáneo.

programme.title: Ejecutivo Agresivo
programme.desc: El empresario Dave Buznik es normalmente afable y nada polémico. Pero tras un altercado a bordo de un avión, es condenado a participar en un programa de gestión de la ira. Allí descubre que su propio instructor, el Dr. Buddy Rydell, tiene un grave problema de ira, un problema que solo se revelará del todo después de que el doctor se traslade a casa de Dave para darle lecciones prácticas sobre "comportamiento calmado".

programme.title: Ligas Mayores
programme.desc: La nueva propietaria de los Indians de Cleveland forma un equipo deliberadamente desastroso para que pierdan y así poder trasladar al equipo. Sin embargo, cuando su plan sale a la luz, los jugadores comienzan a ganar solo para fastidiarla.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Él es el mejor que existe, de hecho, ¡él es el único! Él es Ace Ventura: Detective de mascotas, dedicado a encontrar a la mascota y mariscal de campo de los Miami Dolphins, Dan Marino. Se enfrentará frente a frente con un tiburón devora-hombres, vigilará a los Miami Dolphins y coqueteará con las chicas. Encubierto, abaleado o bajo el agua, siempre consigue a su hombre… o bestia.

programme.title: Hunt For The Wilderpeople
programme.desc: Un niño rebelde y su atolondrado tío adoptivo, quienes se adentran en el bosque luego de una tragedia familiar, ignorantes que su misteriosa desaparición marcará el inicio de una intensa persecución de parte de las autoridades.

programme.title: Robo a mano armada
programme.desc: El capitán Starlight (Sam Neill) se ha convertido en una leyenda.

programme.title: Más valientes que los hombres
programme.desc: Más valientes que los hombres - Una familia fronteriza cruza los Estados Unidos en caravana, con la esperanza de una vida mejor en el territorio de Oregón.

programme.title: Los ángeles vengadores
programme.desc: Miles Utley, un guardaespaldas mormón, se ve forzado a cuestionar sus creencias cuando investiga un caso de asesinato y corrupción inmobiliaria. Su búsqueda de la verdad lo empuja a romper con su comunidad y a enfrentarse a oscuros secretos.

programme.title: El forastero
programme.desc: Historia de amor prohibido entre una joven viuda de un grupo religioso de corte menonita y un pistolero al que acoge en su casa después de que este resulte herido.

programme.title: Jack Hunter y el tesoro perdido de Ugarit
programme.desc: Jack Hunter, arqueólogo, debe robar una tablilla de un museo en Francia y viaja a Damasco tras el asesinato de su amigo. Junto a Nadia y Tariq, enfrenta peligros de Albert Littman y descubre secretos mientras sigue la pista de la reliquia codificada de Ugarit.

programme.title: Pasos firmes
programme.desc: Gustavo, un joven corredor ciego, pierde a su compañero de entrenamiento y comienza a entrenar con Dany, un chico que enfrenta una vida difícil, mientras ambos descubren la fuerza de la amistad y la superación personal.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente 2
programme.desc: El presidente asigna a un especialista en contraterrorismo la tarea de localizar a un terrorista sospechoso de planear la activación de un dispositivo nuclear en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: 11 Grados de Culpa
programme.desc: 11 antiguos compañeros de colegio disfrutan de una fastuosa fiesta y se ven sorprendidos por la inesperada visita de Mónica, que no fue invitada por su escandaloso comportamiento hacia el grupo en el pasado. Esto desata el descontento y la ira de todos los presentes, especialmente de Sandra, la anfitriona. Mónica es asesinada en el jardín de la casa, lo que da lugar a una investigación. Las 11 personas son sospechosas e interrogadas, y cada una de ellas empieza a dar a la investigación un giro diferente, no para distraer de la identidad del asesino, sino para proteger a cada uno de ellos de su oscuro pasado.

programme.title: La conspiración del silencio
programme.desc: El joven fiscal Johann Radmann encuentra unos documentos que le permiten poner en marcha un proceso judicial contra algunos miembros de las SS que sirvieron en Auschwitz. Pero los horrores del pasado y la hostilidad hacia su trabajo lo llevan cerca del colapso, pues le resulta casi imposible abrirse paso a través de un laberinto en el que todo el mundo parece estar implicado o ser culpable.

programme.title: Testigo virtual
programme.desc: Thomas asiste en directo desde su web al asesinato de Cathy. Al querer llamar a la policía se dá cuenta de que no tiene ni su nombre ni su dirección a pesar de llevar varios meses chateando con ella. Thomas se ve implicado en la investigación que realiza Claire, una joven especialista de la delincuencia informática. Las indagaciones les conducen hasta el hermano de Thomas que al parecer tiene relación con una organización criminal que actúa en directo por Internet. Pero a Claire le retiran el asunto de la noche a la mañana. Entonces, ella y Thomas deciden colocar una trampa con la que esperan revelar toda la verdad.

programme.title: Cazador Blanco
programme.desc: Un veterano retirado que está de caza en el norte de Maine se encuentra por accidente con el cadáver de una mujer y una cuantiosa suma de dinero.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Adaptación de la novela Louis De Bernieres basada en un hecho real, narra como un perro kelpie australiano se une a una comunidad minera durante los años setenta.

programme.title: Negociador
programme.desc: Comedia basada en las negociaciones entre el presidente del PSE vasco, Jesús Eguiguren y ETA en 2005 y 2006.

programme.title: Magical Girl
programme.desc: El padre de una niña con una enfermedad terminal está decidido a conceder el último deseo de su hija, un disfraz de coleccionista, ridículamente caro, de una serie de televisión japonesa. La petición lo conducirá a adentrarse en los oscuros y bajos fondos de su ciudad.

programme.title: Marquise
programme.desc: Marquise seduce a René, el actor principal del grupo de teatro de Molière. Él pide su mano y ella acepta, con la condición de que la dejen entrar en el grupo de teatro, pero su talento no está a la altura de su belleza. Más tarde llega Jean Racine, que se enamora de ella....

programme.title: Hijo de Caín
programme.desc: Nico es un adolescente de extraño carácter, inteligencia excepcional y una obsesión: el ajedrez. Carlos y Coral, preocupados por su hijo, contratan al psicólogo infantil Julio Beltrán. Descubrir la verdad a tiempo será la única opción para evitar que la esencia del mal acabe dominando sus vidas.

programme.title: Dirty Shield
programme.desc: Detective Ricardo Colletti's personal life is turned upside down when his wife is raped by members of a notorious street gang. When two of the gang members are found dead, Internal Affairs Bureau makes a bold move to catch their suspect.

programme.title: Vixen
programme.desc: Una hermosa pero mortífera mujer policía china debe formar equipo con un pícaro y apuesto agente de la Interpol para luchar contra los terroristas que se han apoderado del edificio más alto del mundo.

programme.title: 2 Palomas
programme.desc: Un agente inmobiliario amoral y grasiento es presa de una de sus victimas, que se muda silenciosamente a su apartamento y, sin ser visto, comienza una deliciosa y maliciosa campana de venganza. Two Pigeons es una comedia negra con una vena siniestra.

programme.title: The Turnpike Killer
programme.desc: A hulking, vicious homicidal maniac is preying on victims along The New Jersey Turnpike, dumping bodies, keeping people locked indoors and baffling the police. He does all of this at the command of the god-like voices inside his head, telling him to strike night after night. It's up to a troubled NYPD Homicide Detective to put a stop to this reign of terror.

programme.title: Nightmare in Wax
programme.desc: The disfigured curator of a wax museum murders his enemies and then uses their bodies as exhibits in his museum.

programme.title: Cut off (esp)
programme.desc: El policía forense Paul Herzfeld encuentra dentro de la cabeza de un cuerpo mutilado una cápsula que contiene un número de teléfono y el nombre de su hija.

programme.title: 6 Horas: El final
programme.desc: Un joven tiene sólo seis horas para escapar con su mejor amigo de su ciudad natal antes de que explote un reactor nuclear.

programme.title: A ciegas
programme.desc: A police inspector has to solve two gruesome murders. The problem is, his only suspect is a blind man.

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Diez pasajeros de autobús quedan atrapados en un depósito de chatarra tras ser sacados de la carretera por unos motoristas. Para sobrevivir deben improvisar armas y tener las agallas suficientes para defenderse de los asesinos motoristas.

programme.title: Gun Shy: Blanco perfecto
programme.desc: Una desmejorada estrella del rock es secuestrada cuando está de vacaciones en Chile.

programme.title: Testigo Protegido

Encerrada en el hospital donde se recupera, deberá sobrevivir mientras ambos policías intentan matarla. Por suerte, le es asignado un veterano inspector (Bruce Willis) que le ayudará a combatirlos.

programme.title: Zona de caza
programme.desc: Una madre huye de su marido mafioso y de sus peligrosos sicarios que intentan darle caza. Desesperada por encontrar un escondite para ella y sus hijos, se refugia en la cabaña del bosque de un excursionista llamado Jake.

programme.title: El tren de las 3:10
programme.desc: Dan Evans, un ranchero de Arizona y veterano de la Guerra de Secesión, escolta al forajido Ben Wade para ganar dinero. La tensión aumenta cuando se enfrentan a la violencia y a los cómplices de Wade. Nominada a dos Oscar en 2008.

programme.title: En tierras peligrosas

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Shannon presencia un asesinato y huye de policías corruptos. Jack, un exagente, la ayuda a sobrevivir.

programme.title: El Ultimo Soldado Americano
programme.desc: Tras caer prisionero en la jungla de Vietnam, el "Comandante" consigue escapar.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Mercenarios protegen tecnología mortal y rescatan a la hija de un CEO secuestrada por terroristas.

programme.title: 28 Días Después
programme.desc: Al despertar de un coma en un hospital abandonado de Londres, Jim (Cillian Murphy), un mensajero en bicicleta, sale a las calles desiertas de la ciudad en un estado de confusión. Al unir fuerzas con otro grupo de supervivientes, se entera de que se ha liberado un virus mortal. ¿Existe aún esperanza para la humanidad, o el mortífero virus de la «rabia» ha infectado a todo el planeta?

programme.title: Resident Evil: Extinción
programme.desc: Tercera entrega de la saga 'Resident Evil'. En esta ocasión nuestra heroína, junto con los supervivientes de la catástrofe acontecida en la ciudad de Raccoon, deben atravesar el desierto de Nevada con la esperanza de llegar a Alaska, antes de que los de la 'Corporación Umbrella' les alcancen.

programme.title: Fantasy Island

Pero cuando las fantasías se convierten en pesadilla, los huéspedes tendrán que resolver los misterios de la isla para poder escapar vivos. Protagonizada también por Maggie Q, Lucy Hale, Austin Stowell, Jimmy O. Yang y Ryan Hansen. La película está escrita por Jeff Wadlow, Chris Roach y Jillian Jacobs y dirigida por Jef Wadlow.
